hook: Shocked gas in supernova remnant W49B points to cosmic-ray ionization thousands of times the Galactic norm
hook_turn: points to cosmic-ray ionization thousands of times the Galactic norm
summary: ALMA and APEX observations of HCO+ and CO toward W49B show twelve broad-line regions where the remnant is hitting molecular clouds. The high HCO+/CO abundance ratios need cosmic-ray ionization rates 3 to 4 orders of magnitude above the standard Galactic level. That rate is inferred from chemical modeling of a few regions, so it depends on the model assumptions.
title: Molecular signatures of shocked gas and enhanced cosmic-ray ionization in supernova remnant W49B revealed by ALMA
